book.name: 1 Koronti
book.title: Pwoo ɗinshee ɗi Pool ran Nen Koronti mo

content: Tal nKaa mBiise ƊǝMo Kǝ Shìn nKùm Mo
Yaksǝ, pwoo nkaa mbiise ɗi mo kǝ ten shìn nkùm mo, mǝ man nǝnee, <<mun jir mun kǝ man >> Man nii le kǝ gurum ɗyeepkáa, ɗangbe wal nii tap ɗyik gurum kàa rǝret.
Katɗang mee gurum kǝ pan nǝ, wuɗi man mee mbii, ɓe baa wu kǝ man mee mbii kaaɗe nǝ ret kǝ wur man sǝ kas.
Ɗangɓe gwe ɗe kǝ wur wal nNaan, ɓe Naan man gwe mǝnǝ.
Yaksǝ, pwoo nkaa se mbiise ɗe mo kǝ ten shin nǝ nkùm mo, mǝ man azeen nǝ, baa kùm mo kǝ mee seen kas. Kǝzak, mǝ man nǝ, Naan wur a ɓishin ɓejee ɗak.
Koo ɗi pak mbii mo ɗi, ɗe moo pet mo a naan mo, ɗi mo ndǝǝn ɗengnaan, koo ɗe mo ndǝǝn yil ɗesǝ, mbǝɗe naan mo ɗi ɗes, kǝ daa mo ɗi ɗes zak.

Ɗangɓe jir kǝsǝ, ɓe pee mumun ɗi, ɓe Naan wur a mǝndong ɓejee, ɗewur a puun fun, a wur le mbii mo jir, kǝ a mbǝ wur ɗangɓe mun kǝ seen. Daa fun wur a mǝndong ɓejee zak, wur Jesu Kristi, ɗi a ndǝǝn wur ɓe Naan le mbii mo jir, kǝ a ndǝǝn wur ɓe mun kǝ seen.

Ɗangɓe baa a gurum mo jir mo kǝ man zeen ɗesǝ nǝ kas. Pak mo kǝ fes loot kǝ kùm mo hakyeng, har mbǝ cicinsi, ɓe katɗang mo se mbiise, ɓe moo pan nǝ mbiise nǝ a mǝ kùm. Baa pan ɗe mputuup fur nǝ ɓal kas, kǝ mo pan nǝ, wuɗun kǝ ɗee, a ɗewuwat mbǝ mbiise.
Baa mbiise mak jì kǝ mun kus kǝ Naan kas. Koo ɗi mu se mbiise, ɓe baa mun nshee ɗi kas, kǝ koo ɗi baa mu se mbiise kas, ɓe baa mun ntaa mǝ kat kas.
Ɗangɓe wu tap taji katpee fuu mɓe cìn mbii ɗi wuu rǝɓet nǝ ɗee a mbii canshii nen ɗi baa shinzeen fur nǝ ɓal kas.

Mɓǝɗǝ katɗang mee gwar ɗe baa shinzeen fin nǝ ɓal ndǝǝn mbii ɗesǝ mo kas, wur naa gha gwar ɗi waa kǝ man, aa se mbii nlukùm, ɓe baa nǝn nshìn ɓal nwur ndǝǝn pǝtuup wur ɓe kǝ wur se mbiise ɗi mo kǝ ten shin nǝ nkùm kas aa?
Nǝ aasǝ, ɓe shi man fwaa, gha le kǝ ɗyemnǝǝn fwaa ɗi Kristi kǝ muut mɓe wu, wu ɗee a ɗelǝloom.
Katɗang gha cìn mbii mǝnǝ, ɓe gha cìn shikbish nkaa gǝnang, mbǝɗe gha kǝ le kǝ pǝtuup fin ɗi baa nǝ kǝ ɗar ɓalɓal kas nǝ pal, kǝzak, gha cìn shikbish a nkaa Kristi shikáa fin.
Mɓǝmǝnǝ, katɗang mbii ɗe wen nse, nǝn nɗee a mbii le canshii nɗyemnǝǝn fen, ɓe baa wen nkuɗi kǝn se mbiise mǝnǝ zak kas, mbǝkǝ taji wen le kǝ ɗyemnǝǝn fen canshii kas.
